newsitem.title: USA: Grow Biz merchanidse revenue drop was expected.
newsitem.headline: Grow Biz merchanidse revenue drop was expected.

text.p: Grow Biz International Inc said Thursday the merchandise revenue declines it recorded in the fourth quarter and full year were expected.
"This decline was anticipated and reflects the strategic change initiated in 1995 of franchisees sourcing more new product directly from our suppliers," said president Ronald Olson in a statement.

Total revenue declined to $19.8 million from $21.9 million for the quarter and to $91.5 million from $100.2 million for the year. Merchandise sales were $14.7 million compared to $17.9 million in the quarter and $71.7 million, down from $84.0 million for the year.

Grow Biz, which develops and franchises retail concepts for stores that buy and sell new or used merchandise, reported per-share earnings rose to $0.14 from $0.05 in the fourth quarter and to $0.40 from $0.28 for the year.
